notes: Big entrance: fnafmw:big_entrance_door part=0 (origin, bottom-centre) at [22,1,38], facing=south; opening 3 wide (x=21..23) x 3 tall (y=1..3) in the z=38 facade. Outside is +z (z=39, under the cyan_shingle roof eave at y=5..6).

The OPEN sign was the only fnafmw:open_neon_sign and sat at [22,4,38], i.e. inside the wall plane above the door (it replaced a light_facade_bricks wall block). It is removed and the wall block is restored as fnafmw:tan_facade_bricks, matching its direct neighbours [21,4,38], [23,4,38] and [22,5,38].

New OPEN sign at [22,4,39]: exactly one block outside the wall, centred above the door (origin.y+3 = 4), lit=true, powered=false, alt=false, facing=south (same as the door), wall block [22,4,38] stays behind it.
[14,4,36] small_cardboard_box floated (air at [14,3,36], 3 blocks above the floor / the 1-tall large box at [14,1,36]) and was random clutter, so it is removed.

[23,1,8] large_cardboard_box and [29,1,5] large_cardboard_box were inside door openings: the 2-wide parts/service opening at z=8 (door block at [22,1,8]) and the 2-wide employee opening at x=29 z=4..5 (door block at [29,1,4]). Both blocks are conversion artifacts from the old door leaves, so they are removed to unblock the doors.

All other 108 cardboard boxes have solid support directly below (floor at y=0, another box, a full-block party table top, or the checkered stage) and are left untouched. Boxes at y=2 on party tables sit exactly on the tabletop (tabletop model spans y=13..16 of the y=1 cell), so they are not floating.

Sign audit: the two fnafmw:restrooms_neon_sign blocks at [24,3,15] and [24,3,20] (facing=east, lit=true) are correctly mounted on the west face of the solid wall at x=25 and are not embedded - no change. The fnafmw:hazard_sign blocks at [4,2,17], [7,4,13], [7,4,15] and [18,2,32] are likewise each flush against a solid wall. fnafmw:exit_sign [22,4,37] and fnafmw:out_of_order_sign [25,1,30] use the rotation/wall model and are mounted on solid blocks; no change.

Facing convention note: in this mod's models the flat sign plane sits on the edge of the cell in the `facing` direction, so `facing` points at the supporting wall (verified geometrically: open_neon_sign facing=south renders at z=15.98; restrooms_neon_sign facing=east sits next to the wall at x=25). The new OPEN sign therefore keeps the door's outward `facing=south` per the task, and its plane lands at the south edge of the outside cell, tucked under the roof eave.

Remaining risk: because the sign plane is at the outer edge of its own cell, the OPEN sign reads as mounted under the eave roughly one block proud of the facade. If that looks detached in game, the alternative is `facing=north` in the same cell [22,4,39], which puts the plane flush against the wall's outer face (both sides of the texture are readable).

Remaining risk: if the loader also applies the mod's LegacyBlockRules.FLIPPED_FACING list, every flipped facing (including this sign) is applied twice and the sign would end up facing into the wall. Apply only the per-structure facing_map.

Remaining risk: nothing was verified in game; block ids and properties were validated against the new jar's blockstate files (open_neon_sign requires alt/facing/lit/powered; cardboard boxes require facing + variant, large also open).
